_comment: Build tools the release workflow runs, pinned by version and sha256. The workflow fetches each from the generic registry mirror of the Gitea instance named by TLM_REGISTRY_URL and TLM_REGISTRY_OWNER (never from upstream); mirror_path is relative to <registry>/api/packages/<owner>/generic/ and refuses a sha256 mismatch. Seed a mirror once with dev/mirror-tools.sh. To upgrade: change the version, url, file and sha256 here (the sha256 comes from the upstream checksums file) and re-run dev/mirror-tools.sh.
